clauses.reason: Section 14 of EO 11652 of March 8, 1972 (37 FR 5209, held Federal Register text) provides that Executive Order No. 10501 of November 5, 1953, as amended by Executive Orders No. 10816 and the other listed amending orders, "is superseded as of the effective date of this order." Section 15 of EO 11652 states that it "shall become effective on June 1," 1972. EO 10816 only amended EO 10501 and its text was part of EO 10501 as amended, so it ended when the parent order was superseded. The amendment in paragraph 1 (adds a subparagraph to section 4 of EO 10501 on departments without original classification authority) therefore ended on 1972-06-01 by presidential express supersession of the parent order (inclusive reading: the instrument speaks of the effective date, 1972-06-01, so the amendment was operative through May 31, 1972). EO 10964 of September 20, 1961 deleted paragraphs (a), (e), (g), (h) and (i) of section 4 of EO 10501 and inserted replacement paragraphs, one of which restates the subject of this clause (departments that do not have original classification authority but formerly classified material under Executive Order No. 10290); under the owner's strike-and-insert ruling the clause continued, amended, until the parent order was superseded, and the reviewer should note that the section 4 text was rewritten (a substance change).

research_rationale:
EO 10816 (24 FR 3777, signed May 7, 1959; held official Federal Register text) amended Executive Order No. 10501 of November 5, 1953 (safeguarding official information) in three paragraphs: a new subparagraph of section 4, a new Historical Research subparagraph of section 15, and a restated first sentence of section 8(d). EO 11652 section 14 supersedes EO 10501 as amended by EO 10816 and the other listed amending orders as of its effective date, and section 15 makes it effective June 1, 1972, so each clause ended on 1972-06-01 and the order was not in force on 2026-10-14. The inventory is corrected (paragraph 1 had been omitted). EO 11652 itself describes EO 10816 as of May 8, 1959, the filing date, while the register signing date is May 7, 1959; the same instrument is meant. EO 10964 later rewrote section 4 of EO 10501 (a later event on clause 1, not an end).
